notes.title: Kind Words is Now Connected to Kind Words 2
notes.content:
Maybe you've noticed I've been updating Kind Words a lot lately. It's all been in preparation for today!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/]Kind Words 2 is now available![/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/83f4fa23735c6c93477d30a505af34cd64dab9f4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What does this change for the original Kind Words?[/h2]

[list]
[*] More players
[*] More stickers
[/list]
The sequel contains a remaster of the original that runs on the very same server. That means every new Kind Words 2 player is automatically a Kind Words player.

You will be seeing their requests, responses and airplanes! 

Because of you, Kind Words is such an amazing community. We wouldn't dream of splitting it. Two games, one warm internet hug.

Also stickers. Every new sticker for Kind Words 2 is also coming to Kind Words. The first batch already made its way in to circulation during the Kind Words 2 playtests. But today a new batch of 12 stickers will start making their way to your inboxes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/01f4e4739cfa8a3429e09ce933cd730f942603ff.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]What's the difference between the two games?[/h2]

Most of the design of Kind Words 2 was inspired by observing what Kind Words players were trying to do in Kind Words, but that just didn't fit the space.

If you've played a lot of Kind Words, you may have run in to off-topic expressions of joy, creativity, invitations to vent or questions about movies and games. These are all great things to share with people and it always hurts to moderate them away. But the design of Kind Words is so focused on requests for comfort, responses and airplanes, that if we didn't do something, the globally shared inbox could fill up with unanswerable messages.

So Kind Words 2 has new, virtual spaces to handle all the quirky and joyful expressions that players have been trying to find a home for for the last 5 years. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/b26b5c4759b37ae1a07950d4cd32ca6b5f9ffb49.gif[/img][/url]

I could go on, but I don't want to run afoul of Valve's cross-promotion rules :)  The headliner [i]here[/i] is: The game you already own, Kind Words, just got a bit more awesome today.

Thanks for being on this ride with us.


Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/34d0e9971ae25988f5342105827499f6edbf7059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/2b9fca7d61ca278afe2fb04f92d1357bf7e3699e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Announcing: Kind Words 2 (lofi city pop)
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Kind Words Players,[/h1]

We invited you to discuss your worries with strangers. 

It could have gone badly. But, you wrote each other millions of uplifting letters.

You made Kind Words an unlikely success. So we're inviting you back for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/]more....[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/b170f9cad4ebb230cab6d0a081ce6c179d8c2045.gif[/img]

More ways to talk to people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/b26b5c4759b37ae1a07950d4cd32ca6b5f9ffb49.gif[/img]

More ways to be creative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/a83ae7d61e116bcc69a0f7a69c45c31079f64c5c.gif[/img]

More ways to be yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/01f4e4739cfa8a3429e09ce933cd730f942603ff.gif[/img]


[b]Coming in 2024! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/]Wishlist and signup for the playtest today![/url][/b]

For more thrilling details, please hop on over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/]new Kind Words 2 page[/url]. It would mean the world to us if you wishlist it today. Thanks.

Since this news item is specifically going out to Kind Words players, I want to explain how we're NOT splitting the community and how we WILL be supporting the original Kind Words.

Along side all its glorious new features, Kind Words 2 includes a remade version of the original game that is fully backwards compatible.

[h2]Kind Words and Kind Words 2 players can send letters back and forth to each other.[/h2]

Every new Kind Words 2 player is also a new Kind Words player. Everyone is on the same server. Your letters, your stickers and your favorites are waiting for you no matter which version you play.

We're very excited to have everyone  join us in our new lofi city. We've finished a lot of the game, but we've set aside time to gather feedback from people and make it even better. One of the ways we're doing that is using Steam's playtest feature. 

If that excites you, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/]checkout the KW2 page and sign up[/url]!

Yours, 
Ziba and Luigi

PS. Clark is back with a whole new soundtrack!

notes.title: Our Favorite Update!
notes.content:
Ok, now this is just getting silly. Kind Words has been out for four years and people are still writing [i][b]THOUSANDS OF LETTERS EVERY DAY[/b][/i].

Well then, I guess we'll keep updating it!

Thanks to the big server overhaul we did last month, we can add something people have been asking for from the very beginning: 

[h2]Favorites![/h2]

You can now [i][b]curate a collection of your favorite airplanes and letters[/b][/i] that you have received. 

See an airplane you want to hold on to? Click favorite. Don't worry, You're making a copy. Its good vibes will still float on to the next person.

Really love a response you got and don't want to dig through your whole inbox to re-read it every time? Favorite it!

[b]To read your favorites, just click the new heart icon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/6f90d322afd571b0c2a52105dea03b57f64df79d.gif[/img]

Currently you are limited to having 500 favorites. We will be looking at feedback, player behavior and server load to see if that's the right limit. You can always remove favorites to make more room.

We've also added a handful of other improvements, because, gosh darn it, you're worth it.

[h3]Full Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a favorites system
[*] Moved the screensavers button to the "more" section
[*] Updated help page text and links
[*] Letter response font will auto-size if it's too long to fit on the page
[*] Changed the quit icon from a pillow to an open door
[*] Changed the decorate room icon from a face to a room
[*] Made camera grain effect stay constant with screen resolution changes
[*] Made the request input field behave like airplanes and responses when reaching the size limit
[*] Fixed a soft lock that could occur if making a report failed
[*] Fixed an issue checking the validity of a sticker granted by a thanks
[*] Replaced Twitter link with [url=https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@popcannibal]Mastodon link[/url]
[*] Removed the "3 Year" badge. Cause it's 4 years now.
[/list]

With much gratitude for our players who are [i]our favorites[/i],

Ziba & Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/34d0e9971ae25988f5342105827499f6edbf7059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/2b9fca7d61ca278afe2fb04f92d1357bf7e3699e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Scheduled Downtime: 8/8/23 11pm GMT-4 for 4 hours
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Short version: [/h1][/h2]

Gotta turn off Kind Words for a few hours to update the server. 
Also, there's a small, fun update to the game coming soon.

[h2][h1]Long version:[/h1][/h2]

If you've been following along with our folksy little updates all these years, you may be familiar with this theme: We didn't expect Kind Words to be popular and I didn't design the server thinking lots of people would actually use it.  That caused some growing pains for all of us. 

A few [i]years[/i] ago I started rewriting the server for better performance and extensibility. I don't want to jinx it, but I've [i]actually tested[/i] the new server for high loads unlike when we launched the current one.

It's going to take a few hours to do the upgrade because our database is around 7 gigabytes in size and I don't want to lose any of your messages. So first I'm gonna backup the existing database, which takes about a half hour. Then I need to convert the database to my totally redesigned format. That should take about an hour.

Let's assume something will go wrong, double that and add a little and I'm estimating 4 hours.

Boy do I hope nothing goes wrong.

The best thing about this server update is that it will let us do some new things with the game. And I know that everyone longs to open steam to be greeted by a monologue about server upgrades, so to thank you for your attention, I'm going to reward you with a tease for our next game update: we're adding a "favorites" system so you can curate your own little collection of the kindest of words.

notes.title: Kind Words Vinyl Record!
notes.content:
Players have been asking for a record for ages. Sorry it took us a while to get here, but we wanted do it right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/eb2f502a6947a6092a73273c6be2d1a9f7f44198.png[/img]

Records are about the music (and you'll get Clark's beautiful tracks), but they're also a keepsake. A physical manifestation of your personal connection to a feeling you love. That's why we crafted this as a little bundle of the best parts of Kind Words made real. 

That's why you get:
[list]
[*] Clark Aboud's lo-fi & dreamy tracks
[*] A choice of "Pink and Violet Firefly Swirl" or "Midnight Purple Mixtape"
[*] Two postcards to write nice letters on and send to people!
[*] A sheet of stickers from the game! You could put them on the postcards!
[*] It's like you're playing the game in real life!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/d5dde00608654c6888566713f6d5a1cbb2f8af6d.png[/img]

Bring a little joy in to your life AND those around you!

notes.title: Save File Manager
notes.content:
How sexy is that, right? We added a save file manager! 
Even better:[i] I recommend you never ever use it![/i] 
Wow! These updates just get better and better!

In all seriousness, for 99% of people you don't need to ever think twice about your save file. There should be only one and there should be no problem with it.

However, this save file manager is for you if:
* You're on a mac and your save file seems to have disappeared recently.
* You don't use steam cloud but you manually copy save files between computers.
* Something really weird that shouldn't have happened, happened.

This new tool, accessed from the options page, will help you discover and select what save file to use.

Hopefully on to funnerer stuff now!

notes.title: Small fixes: Duck Kami sticker, deleting responses and changing signature.
notes.content:
Small fixes:
[list]
[*] Stopped the Duck Kami sticker from looking like a Bleeper when you put it on a letter.
[*] Fixed not being able to delete responses if your inbox was sorted by request.
[*] Changing your signature initial used to have a delay before being reflected locally.
[*] Clicking on the version on the title screen now takes you to the steam news page instead of the static game website.
[/list]

That's all. If you're like me, you might have noticed an update for a game you care about and then clicked on the news only to be slightly disappointed that it's just bugfixes for bugs you didn't even notice.
Sorry. That's all that needed changing right now. But I CAN give you a little update on some behind the scenes dev stuff if you're just hungry for some Kind Words goings on.

Moderation is a big job for us and we take it seriously. We're always looking for ways to do it better and more efficiently.

You ever read those jokes where it's like: "We fed 10,000 movie scripts in to an AI and asked it to write Robocop 5!"

Well... we've actually got the sort of dataset with Kind Words that just might be right for that kind of AI. We've got around 4 million organized text entries and 200,000 moderation actions. Now, "feeding it to an AI and asking it to moderate" isn't entirely straight forward. There's a bit of data science and statistics to do. And the biggest catch is: I need to do it myself. We take our privacy policy very seriously. I'm never going to hand off our database to a third party, no matter how good they are at feeding it to machines.

So that's what I've been up to. Dusting off my python. Reading up on support-vector machines. Connecting PHP and Python in ways God never intended. I've got a LONG way to go, but I'm excited to say I did a first test in the production environment today and it has already flagged several questionable messages for review. I don't know if it'll ever get to the point where I trust it to make final decisions, but damn is it cool to be trying.

Cheers,
Ziba

notes.title: Pink Lemonade
notes.content:
[h2]Two years in and over 4 million messages sent![/h2] 

[h3]If you're not gonna stop then we're not gonna either![/h3] 
New stickers for everybody! You get a three-eyed duck thing! And a sleepy octopus! And .... a jelly...cube...with... bones? Maybe those are french fries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/f18aec2f486131f492d3618e2ea5eaffa49e3c55.gif[/img]

Because Kind Words is a chill place and strives to be a bit of the opposite of traditional social media, we don't flash a lot of numbers in the game. No online player count. No ticker with announcements or tournaments. [i](note to self: what would a Kind Words tournament be?)[/i] So every now and then we get two questions:
[olist]
[*] Is anyone playing Kind Words?
[*] Is anyone moderating Kind Words?
[/olist]
The answer to both is: heck yes, all the time.

Usage goes up and down, but on a slow day, we're still transmitting a couple thousand letters between players. 

And we are moderating constantly and always improving our moderation tools. For every update to the game, I make 10 updates to the backend. Faster, smarter, stronger, purpler. Also, we. Hold on. Duck...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/f1fbd6d9b2d92bd09f80031ef40a374d28c62422.png[/img]

Where was I? Anyways, speaking of moderation, with this update we're doing two things to help keep things kind and on-topic. 

First, we're letting people directly delete responses they no longer want to have in their inboxes.

Second, we're going to ask you to confirm some things before you try to do them like... are you trying to send a stranger your discord handle? Or your email? And we'll gently remind you that we gotta keep it anonymous to keep it safe.

Full change notes:
[list]
[*] New room!
[*] New stickers!
[*] Added the ability to delete responses you've received.
[*] Sorted unopened letters to show up on top of your pile.
[*] Will ask you to confirm before sending if it looks like you're breaking rules.
[*] Prevented the escape key from erasing what you just typed.
[*] Updated to Unity 2020.3.16
[/list]

Thanks once more for living this wild experiment in caring with us.

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Midwinter Update! New Room! New Stickers! Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
We're at a year and change now and you haven't slowed down! You're still writing each other[i][b] thousands of messages every day[/b][/i].

We are humbled to have Kind Words become a regular part of so many people's lives and, in keeping with long-standing international custom for developer-player relations, we offer you this traditional gift: a giant, looming beast and some mittens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/53f0b4b0c46feb1ff753e8090f5e9d3a0645c0dc.jpg[/img]

In fact, since you've exchanged [i][b]well over 3 million messages[/b][/i], we are soaring past the the beast-mitten requirement to bring you:

[list]
[*] A new room in a warm wooden cabin with a string of twinkling lights!
[*] Steam trading cards!
[*] 10 new stickers! Each with matching room objects. Including this guy...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/ea1d1ae4a72abdec88f609532890231bac3fd896.gif[/img]

What the lil' green penguin is saying is that we've also made a host of less sexy, but desirable little changes too.

[list]
[*] More efficient and error tolerant network code.
[*] Autofocusing on text input fields whenever they appear.
[*] The request list is refreshed every time you view it.
[*] Fixed a bug which could cause new stickers not to get the big fanfare they deserve when first seen.
[*] The options menu can now be accessed from the title screen.
[*] Lowered the volume. Why was it so loud?
[*] Updated the underlying engine to Unity 2019.4.18.
[*] Showing a "connecting..." message on the title screen if it's taking too long to connect. So that you know what it's up to. It's trying to connect.
[/list]

It's a joy to watch you help each other and a privilege to shepherd your voices.

Take care out there. We're in this together.

Yours,
Ziba and Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/34d0e9971ae25988f5342105827499f6edbf7059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/2b9fca7d61ca278afe2fb04f92d1357bf7e3699e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Evergreen Anniversary: New Room! New Stickers! Screen Savers!?!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Steamiversary![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/d71d5b12c8f95b996692dfab738b4b25702f0d56.jpg[/img]

It's been a year since Kind Words launched on Steam! And what an incredible birth of a community is has been!

You've exchanged over TWO MILLION messages. More importantly, we keep hearing from people how much those messages mean to them. We'd love to take credit, but you all put your hearts on your sleeves and you all responded. So please take a moment to recognize the gifts you've given each other.

The best thanks that we can think of is to keep it fresh with new content.

[h2]Musical Interlude[/h2]
If you really want to set the mood as you read on about the AMAZING NEW STUFF, here's a treat:
Kind Words' composer [url=https://clarkaboudmusic.bandcamp.com/album/lavender-for-electric-guitars-from-kind-words]Clark Aboud has rearranged one of his favorite tracks, Lavender, for a trio of electric guitars[/url]!

[h2]A New Room![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/7030ab9593eab080c0eeee2cb23fdb4cdbe33cf0.jpg[/img]

The new Evergreen room is like bright sunlight filtering through leaves above.

[h2]More stickers for everybody![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/683c7da96c39cd6d73e2f1f35333fd377fe24c51.jpg[/img]
I don't want to spoil all the surprises, but there's an Axolotl and a ghost. And they're cute as fu...n times ahead for everyone!

[h2]Screen Savers! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/b6d3fa6910184eeca3e2ee17e17cc25089869fe8.gif[/img]
We know a lot of you are leaving Kind Words on in the background to listen to the music or wait for replies. So now you can do that with style. We've included three screen saver modes which fade out the UI and intensify the chill. (One can intensify chill, right?).

Even better, the screen savers have an option to automatically display airplane messages from other players. You've written about 400,000 airplanes.  And now you can just relax and let them float directly in to your heart.  

Hmm. This is getting a little saccharine.

Good thing I saved the least emotional bits for last!

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements![/h2]

That is, unless you get weepy about ultra-wide monitors. Cause baby: we now have much better support for ultra-wide monitors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/2529fd383a5233f3edb16f80602da47181b7f320.jpg[/img]

Or maybe your heart has been yearning for this little checkbox:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/ef779547661b5e360d064535aba59aa51c6203b9.jpg[/img]

Also:
[list]
[*] Fixed a couple problems preventing Ella from alerting you about new letters.
[*] You can cancel out of reporting a message without selecting a reason first.
[*] No more sending empty airplanes! People weren't really abusing it. But it was silly.
[*] The scarecrow sticker is no longer sideways in a bunch of places. That wacky guy.
[*] Upgraded the game engine (Unity) to 2019.4.10
[*] Somehow the whole thing is a couple megabytes smaller. Not really sure how that happened. Bit gremlins probably.
[/list]

With sincere appreciation for all your kindness,
Ziba and Luigi

notes.title: Million Letter Update: New room! New stickers!
notes.content:
[h2]A Million Letters![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/3b2083bada2425371304ba4a3ec4923a78ca4461.png[/img]

Kind Words' big hearted players have written each other [i][b]a million letters[/b][/i]. 

That's not counting the [b][i]300,000 paper airplanes[/i][/b] with words of encouragement you've thrown. 

No, that's specifically letters written in response to strangers' requests for comfort or advice. Almost every word and every minute of that time was focused on lifting up another person. You players have done something amazing!

[h2]New Room and Stickers![/h2]

The least we could do in response was to stick a cute frog in the game.

Also, we like you so much that we decided to do more than the least. Today we've added 
[list]
[*] [b]10 new stickers[/b]
[*] each with a [b]new decoration[/b] 
[*] and a [b]new blue room[/b] in which to enjoy them!
[/list]

But wait! There's more!

[h2]New Inbox[/h2]

You're writing so much more than we ever imagined that our interfaces weren't keeping up. We've reorganized the inbox. Now you can view your messages sorted either by newest responses or grouped together by request.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/432a33efe67521145e9569e8fade0dc2d09fc466.png[/img]

Both modes will stream in your letters from the server as you browse, allowing you to keep a library of hundreds of letters without your computer breaking a sweat. There are more improvements needed for our most prolific writers, but this should help!

[h2]Options Galore![/h2]

There's a new options button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/64d5caf557aca56636a78753f47bf1b166ebfed0.png[/img]

Which goes to the new options menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/eda793a60817bc38e7b69da63f7718ea3b91c205.jpg[/img]

It has toggles for toggling toggle-able options!

[list]
[*] A buffet of graphical options!
[*] You can change the signature that is automatically appended to letters!
[*] A wildly dangerous button for erasing your save game! (It does ask you to confirm)
[/list]

[h2]Various Things That I've Lumped Under One Heading[/h2]
[list]
[*] Big performance improvements for older machines
[*] A warning if you start the game on a computer that's probably too old to play it
[*] Link to the FAQ in help
[*] Minor visual contrast improvements on the help screen
[*] 27.8MB smaller, even with the new room!
[*] Updated to Unity 2019.3
[/list]

[h2]Dramatic Conclusion[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/53e176c95d56907b2358d73b5cfc96eb3ad621c8.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for playing!

Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: New Music!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/1f2e7ee0ffc2583088c913ac95f77fd3dab25748.gif[/img]

[b]More lofi! More chill! More beats![/b]

You may recall that Ella, the female mail deer, has a side gig bringing you fresh tunes every day that you write a letter. Well, she just found SEVEN more tracks. Just keep coming back to write and they're yours.

[b]Mildly compelling backstory[/b]
Before launching, I daydreamed: "If this thing actually took off, I'd love to commission more music". Well, you all made my dream come true. Clark Aboud has produced 7 new tracks that go in to the game today.

They have a wider range of feeling, including a triplet of "Connector" pieces that are like deep breathing for your ears. 

The new music is also now in the soundtrack DLC plus we've added lossless FLAC format recordings of everything. 

[b]More feelings[/b]
I'm so honored that people are choosing to spend their time here and proud of all the effort players have made to lift each other up.

Also, I fixed some bugs and tweaked some things!

[b]Full changelog![/b]
[list]
[*] 7 new songs
[*] Added a volume slider for sound effects (really just Ella's voice)
[*] Removed a game stutter when changing music
[*] Fixed a bug which would announce the wrong stickers on game start
[*] Fixed a song ordering issue when viewing the radio after unlocking a track
[*] Fixed the mental health link when composing airplanes
[*] Fixed a tutorial typo 
[*] Fixed a bug which made letters with no stickers appear to have the Elegy sticker
[*] Upgraded to Unity 2019.4.11f1
[*] Did, like, 80 million things to the server to make moderation easier and prevent the whole enterprise from melting down.
[/list]

notes.title: 250,000 Letters!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/0b645efe87ea73cac647a79f68f9df7fd1005448.gif[/img]

[h1]A Quarter Million![/h1]

You kind people have already written [b]250,000 letters[/b] to each other! 

When we dreamed up this little trust experiment, we never imagined it would get this big. In fact, before launch I did a stress test on the server with 60,000 fake messages and laughed to myself [i]"hah, we'll NEVER get close to that"[/i].

(Thank you all for bearing with us through brief server meltdown that followed.)

It has been a crazy few weeks improving the servers, fixing bugs, streamlining our moderator tools, and talking to hundreds people on [url=discord.gg/popcannibal]discord[/url], email, [url=twitter.com/popcannibal]twitter[/url] and [url=reddit.com/r/kindwords]reddit[/url]!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
It's a bit overwhelming, but we've been lifted up by your enthusiasm, positivity and fan art. More importantly, thank you for what you're doing for each other. It's a privilege for us to be facilitating such heart warming exchanges as are happening every minute through Kind Words.

[h1]Now more![/h1]
We're blinking the joyful sparkles of astonishment out of our eyes now and getting back to work. THERE WILL BE MORE STICKERS! Just you wait and see ;)

Fun fact, I took so long making that sexy looping celebratory video that you've actually hit 271k already!

You can see the video with sound [url=twitter.com/popcannibal/status/1178819502802378753]on twitter[/url]

oh god I'm so corny.

notes.title: Kind Airplanes?!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/2edcc02ea4d5ed0456458166d040d8b21662d1d6.gif[/img]

Big update today for Kind Words Steam beta testers and Humble owners!

[h1]Paper Airplanes![/h1]

One of the weirdest, most wonderful problems I've ever had in my entire game design career is that Kind Words has too many people just bubbling over with kindness and clogging up the request queue with loving statements of support and joy!

What am I supposed to do, tell you to stop?! 

So today you get paper airplanes. These airplanes are just the place for you to send your thanks to the world, to an individual, share an inspirational quote, or maybe even just scream and vent some strong emotions.

Your words will fly through everybody else's worlds and everyone can click on them to read our shared stream of thoughts.


[h1]Full History[/h1]
Your inbox only shows you the newest responses to your requests for letters. This helps keep things speedy for the servers. Now there's also a full history browser that will let you chronologically browse all your requests and responses, no matter how many.

[h1]More[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam cloud saving!
[*] Updated mixes for all music tracks!
[*] Music volume slider!
[*] More reporting options!
[*] Secret stuff that's not unlocked yet but might turn out to be new stickers. Who knows?!
[/list]

It's been a fantastic couple months leading up to the full Steam launch. Over 40,000 letters written! You folks are the best. Keep being kind and get hyped for beautiful new players you'll be talking to after the upcoming release!
